verdictDetail: Re-verification of correction commit e32673e (on top of frozen candidate 6fb2285). Independent checks confirm most corrections: the CSV is now 48 governed rows with the same sourceIds, statuses, URLs and retrieval dates as data/legal-sources.json (0 mismatches); the D02 source table (48/48) and requirement table (51/51) match; dossier §2 per-source verificationStatus matches the governed register for every shared source (50 §2 blocks: 46 governed + 4 considered-only marked NOT_IN_GOVERNED_REGISTER, 0 status mismatches); the stale 2025-02-01 RED date is now 2025-08-01; SCA RTS entry into force is 2018-03-14 in both JSON and dossier; WEEE wording, the pilotCoverage typo, the LGP UNDETERMINED status, the D02 conservative-negative rule, the D20 54/54 + CI disclosure, and the class C INTERNAL_ONLY claims (7 internal / 35 public-prohibited summaries consistent) are corrected. The frozen gate is 54/54 and the suite 41/41 at e32673e, and 6/6 fresh auditor mutations are detected. However, four correction items are not cleanly closed: A-01 (MAJOR) is only partially corrected — the dossier's §1 key-date table (14 rows) and §3 transposition table (6 rows) still label sources RE_VERIFIED whose governed status is CONSUMED_FROM_PREDECESSOR_EVIDENCE (CRA, GPSR, DCD, UCPD, eCommerce, RD 186/2016, RD 187/2016, NMEA 2000 licensing, NMEA 0183, NMEA certification), so the same document still carries two conflicting statuses per source and its note 'no source carries two verification statuses' is false, and its §0 arithmetic (48 + 4 + 2) contradicts its own 48 - 2 + 4 = 50 membership rule; A-04 was claimed but D19 was not modified (84/84 bundle assessments still omit the declared legalSourceIds/requirementIds/evidenceRequired); A-05 was claimed but D03 lines 216/237 still shorten the governed WEATHER/FLEET BATTERIES rationales; A-06 is only partially fixed (D15, website-findings.json and D18 now use the real unprefixed paths, but data/mc15-handoff-inputs.json lines 137/146/155/162 still contain /legal/aviso-legal, /legal/privacidad, /legal/cookies and /tienda/checkout, none of which exists in LOCALIZED_ROUTES). Because one MAJOR defect (A-01) remains open, no internal-scope award is issued now (fail-closed per the audit rule). Once A-01, A-04, A-05 and A-06 are actually closed and re-verified, the evidence supports PASS_INTERNAL_LEGAL_GOVERNANCE_SCOPE with programme status PARTIAL: internal legal/commercial governance PASS, external legal clearance NOT_GRANTED (mirroring MC-13). No sale, certification, legal clearance, insurance, licence, publication, merge or deployment is authorised by this record.
